_about_en: Teaching packs are written by My Culture Connect to go with Dom Jones's lesson plans. Dom chooses the week's power vocabulary; the Chinese, the examples and the practice sets here are ours, so that a teacher can run her plan with no preparation. Kept in a separate file from data/lesson-plans.json so that re-importing Dom's PDF never overwrites our additions, and so it stays obvious which words are whose.
_about_zh: 教學包由人師教育協會編寫，搭配 Dom Jones 的教案使用。每週的核心字彙是 Dom 選的；這裡的中文、例句與練習是我們加的，目的是讓老師不必備課就能把她的教案上完。刻意與 lesson-plans.json 分檔，重新匯入 Dom 的 PDF 不會蓋掉我們加的東西，也一眼看得出哪部分是誰寫的。

1.prep_en: No preparation needed. Read the lightning round off the screen. Students need one sheet of paper for their Word Bank.
1.prep_zh: 不必備課。中翻英練習直接照螢幕唸。學生只需要一張紙做自己的單字銀行。

words.example: Let me introduce myself — my name is Yi-Chen and I play basketball.
Tell me about one experience you had this summer.
Speaking English for sixty seconds is my challenge today.
This year I want to improve my listening.
She felt confident when she answered in English.
Good learners stay curious — they always ask why.
What is your favorite food in your hometown?
Today you will discover how many English words you already know.

practice.title_zh: 中翻英快問快答
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min speed round. Read the Chinese, students race to say the English. All eight words appear.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的 Speed Round。唸中文，學生搶答英文。八個字全部出現。
items: 我想介紹我的家人。 → I want to introduce my family.
那是一次很棒的體驗。 → That was a great experience.
這對我來說是一個挑戰。 → This is a challenge for me.
我想改善我的發音。 → I want to improve my pronunciation.
她說英文的時候很有自信。 → She is confident when she speaks English.
我對你的暑假很好奇。 → I am curious about your summer.
你最喜歡的科目是什麼？ → What is your favorite subject?
我今天發現了一個新單字。 → I discovered a new word today.

practice.title_zh: 六十秒自我介紹・句型架構
practice.note_en: Put these on the board. A1 students fill in two frames; B1 and above should link them into one flowing minute.
practice.note_zh: 寫在白板上。A1 學生填兩句就好；B1 以上要把句子串成流暢的一分鐘。
items: My name is ______ and my favorite ______ is ______.
One experience I will never forget is ______.
This year I want to improve my ______.
I feel confident when I ______.
I am curious about ______.

practice.title_zh: 同義反義對決
practice.note_en: Two teams. Say the word, the other team must answer with a synonym or an opposite.
practice.note_zh: 分兩隊。唸出單字，另一隊要接出同義詞或反義詞。
items: confident ↔ nervous / shy
curious ↔ bored
improve ↔ get worse
discover ≈ find out
challenge ≈ difficult task
favorite ≈ the one I like best

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一人一句
practice.note_en: Dom's plan asks every student to produce something before leaving. This is the smallest version that still counts.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的教案要求每個學生離開前都要產出東西。這是最小、但仍然算數的版本。
items: Today I discovered that I already know about ______ English words.
This year I want to improve my ______.

2.prep_en: No preparation needed. Write 'I like dogs.' on the board and build from there. Note that this week's eight words are the lesson itself: three adjectives, three adverbs, two conjunctions — the exact materials a sentence grows with.
2.prep_zh: 不必備課。在白板寫下「I like dogs.」就能開始。請注意：本週八個字本身就是這堂課——三個形容詞、三個副詞、兩個連接詞，正好是把句子養大的三種材料。

words.example: The library was quiet, so we could hear the rain outside.
My grandmother brought out an enormous mooncake after dinner.
He quickly wrote the new word in his notebook.
She carefully carried the hot soup to the table.
The last ten minutes of the game were exciting.
words.more: ↔ boring · 小心：exciting 是「令人興奮的」，excited 是「（人）感到興奮的」

words.example: Surprisingly, my little brother finished the race first.
Although it rained, we still went outside to look at the moon.
words.more: ≈ though, even though · 小心：英文只用一個連接詞，不說 Although…, but…

words.example: We had a barbecue because it was Mid-Autumn Festival.
words.more: because 接原因，so 接結果 · 小心：不能同一句用「Because…, so…」

practice.title_en: The Sentence Builder · a worked ladder
practice.title_zh: 句子養成梯・示範
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Show this ladder first so students see where they are going, then start a new one as a class. Every rung adds one kind of information.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。先示範這道梯子，讓學生看見終點在哪，再全班一起爬一道新的。每一階只加一種訊息。
items: I like dogs.
+ adjective → I like enormous dogs.
+ adverb → I quietly play with enormous dogs.
+ because → I quietly play with enormous dogs because they are friendly.
+ although → Although my mother says no, I quietly play with the enormous dog next door because he is surprisingly friendly. (19 words)
Now start a new ladder: “We eat mooncakes.” / “The class is noisy.” / “She runs.”

practice.title_zh: 句子升級・五個字變十二個字
practice.note_en: This is exactly the homework Dom sets, so run one in class first. Model answer given for the first item.
practice.note_zh: 這正是 Dom 出的回家作業，所以課堂上先帶一題。第一題附示範答案。
items: The boy ran. → Although he was tired, the boy ran quickly to the bus stop because the rain was getting heavy. (20 words)
We watched the moon. → ______
My father cooks. → ______
The test was hard. → ______
They played a game. → ______

practice.title_zh: 兩個中文帶來的陷阱
practice.note_en: Both of this week's conjunctions have a matching pair in Chinese that English does not use. Expect these errors — they are not carelessness, they are the first language showing through. Fix them together.
practice.note_zh: 本週兩個連接詞在中文裡都是成對出現，英文卻只用一個。學生一定會犯——那不是粗心，是母語在說話。一起把它們改過來。
items: 雖然下雨，但是我們還是出門了。 ✗ Although it rained, but we still went out. ✓ Although it rained, we still went out.
因為月亮很亮，所以我們在外面吃。 ✗ Because the moon was bright, so we ate outside. ✓ Because the moon was bright, we ate outside.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Although the mooncake was enormous, but I finished it.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Because I practiced carefully, so I improved quickly.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個長句
practice.note_en: One sentence about Mid-Autumn Festival, at least twelve words, using because or although and one word from this week.
practice.note_zh: 寫一句中秋節的句子，至少十二個字，要用到 because 或 although，加上本週任一個單字。
items: Example: Although the night was quiet, our family laughed a lot because we barbecued together.
Your sentence: ______

3.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom sets three families rather than single words — the point is the shape of the word, not the word. The ending tells you the job: -ness / -tion / -ty make nouns, -ful / -ive make adjectives, -ly makes adverbs, un- flips the meaning.
3.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 這週給的是三個詞族而不是三個單字——重點是字的形狀，不是字本身。字尾就是職稱：-ness／-tion／-ty 變名詞，-ful／-ive 變形容詞，-ly 變副詞，un- 把意思翻面。

words.example: The beauty of Lukang is in its old streets.
We took a photo in front of the beautiful temple.
She sings beautifully.
The whole class was happy when the bell rang.
Happiness is a warm bowl of beef noodles.
They happily walked home together.
He looked unhappy about the test result.
words.more: un- → 相反（un- 加在形容詞前面）

words.example: Each team will create a poster about their hometown.
words.more: 家族 ③　原形是動詞

words.example: That is a creative way to solve the problem.
The students showed their creations to the whole school.

practice.title_en: Word Family Factory · one root, fully built
practice.title_zh: 詞族工廠・示範一個字根
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Build this one on the board first, then hand each team a root. Ask for a sentence with every form — a form they cannot use in a sentence does not count.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。先在白板上把這個字根長完，再發給每組一個字根。每種形式都要造句——造不出句子的形式不算數。
items: care (v./n.) → I care about my grandmother.
careful (adj.) → Be careful on the stairs.
carefully (adv.) → He carefully opened the box.
careless (adj.) → A careless mistake cost us the game.　(-less = 沒有)
carelessness (n.) → Her carelessness broke the cup.
Team roots: teach · help · use · friend · hope · safe

practice.title_en: Suffix detective · the ending tells you the job
practice.title_zh: 字尾偵探・字尾就是職稱
practice.note_en: Say each word, students call out noun, adjective or adverb — from the ending alone, without knowing the meaning. That is the whole skill of this week.
practice.note_zh: 唸出每個字，學生只看字尾就喊出名詞、形容詞或副詞——不必知道意思。這就是本週要練的唯一技能。
items: kindness → ？　　darkness → ？　　(-ness = 名詞)
colorful → ？　　powerful → ？　　(-ful = 形容詞)
slowly → ？　　suddenly → ？　　(-ly = 副詞)
invention → ？　　decision → ？　　(-tion / -sion = 名詞)
unfair → ？　　unlucky → ？　　(un- = 相反)
Harder — one root, all three: active · activity · actively

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese words do not change shape
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文的字不會變形
practice.note_en: In Chinese, 美 stays 美 whether it is a noun, an adjective or an adverb — the sentence decides. English changes the word itself. This is why students say 'She sings beautiful'. It is not carelessness; the first language simply has no such rule.
practice.note_zh: 中文裡「美」不管當名詞、形容詞還是副詞都是「美」，靠句子決定。英文卻要把字本身改掉。這就是為什麼學生會說 She sings beautiful——不是粗心，母語裡根本沒有這條規則。
items: 她唱得很美。 ✗ She sings beautiful. ✓ She sings beautifully.
他很有創意。 ✗ He is creation. ✓ He is creative.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ The children played happy in the park.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I felt happiness when I saw my grades.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · and a sign hunt
practice.title_zh: 出場券・順便獵一張告示
practice.note_en: The exit ticket first. The sign hunt is Dom's culture connection — English word families are all over Taiwanese campuses and menus once you start looking.
practice.note_zh: 先寫出場券。獵告示是 Dom 指定的文化連結——開始留意之後，會發現台灣校園和菜單上到處都是英文詞族。
items: Exit ticket: pick one root, write three forms, use one in a sentence.
Sign hunt: photograph one English sign this week and bring the word family.
Starters you will actually find: Recycle / Recycling / Recyclable
Safety / Safe / Safely　·　Entrance / Enter　·　Delicious (menus)

4.prep_en: No preparation needed. Dom's four sets are ladders, not lists: each one climbs from an ordinary word to a strong one. Teach the rungs, not the words.
4.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 這週給的四組是階梯，不是清單：每一組都從一個普通的字爬到一個有力的字。教的是階，不是字。

words.example: The soup was good.
Her pronunciation is excellent.
He gave an outstanding performance at the school concert.
The weather was bad on Sunday.
Forgetting the tickets was disastrous.
I am happy to see you.
We were delighted when she won.
The team was ecstatic after the last-second goal.
That is a big box.
An enormous banyan tree stands in front of the temple.
words.more: ★★☆ 上週學過，這週再用一次

words.example: The typhoon caused colossal damage to the harbor.

practice.title_zh: 單字升級拍賣會・拍賣品
practice.note_en: For the 35–50 min activity. Six weak sentences go under the hammer. Teams bid imaginary money; the best upgrade wins the lot. Pay more for precise, less for merely longer.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 35–50 分鐘的活動。六個軟弱的句子上台拍賣，各組用假錢競標，升級得最好的隊伍得標。精準才值錢，只是變長不值錢。
items: Lot 1　The night market food was good.
Lot 2　Our school trip was bad.
Lot 3　She was happy about her test.
Lot 4　The temple is big.
Lot 5　The movie was very very good.
Lot 6　I had a bad day and a bad dinner.

practice.title_zh: 別爬過頭
practice.note_en: Chinese turns up the volume with 很 / 非常 / 超 on the same word, so students reach for 'very very good'. English changes the word instead — but the top rung is for big occasions. 'I was ecstatic about my sandwich' is funny, not strong. Pick the rung that fits the event.
practice.note_zh: 中文用「很／非常／超」在同一個字上加大音量，所以學生會說 very very good。英文是換字——但最高一階要留給大場面。I was ecstatic about my sandwich 只會很好笑。挑對階，不是挑最高階。
items: Your friend passed a small quiz. → happy or ecstatic?
Taiwan won an Olympic gold medal. → happy or ecstatic?
Your lunch box was nice today. → good or outstanding?
A classmate saved someone's life. → good or outstanding?
It rained during your picnic. → bad or disastrous?

practice.title_zh: 萬聖節單字銀行
practice.note_en: Dom's October connection. Same upgrade move, spooky but gentle — good for a warm-up or for the auction lots if the class wants a theme.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的十月連結。一樣是升級的動作，但換成萬聖節主題，嚇人而不嚇壞——可以當暖身，或直接拿來當拍賣品。
items: scary → spooky (★★☆) → terrifying (★★★)
dark → gloomy (★★☆) → pitch-black (★★★)
old → ancient (★★★)
strange → mysterious (★★☆) → eerie (★★★)
Example: The old house was dark and scary. → The ancient house was gloomy and terrifying.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・升級並說明理由
practice.note_en: Dom's homework asks students to explain two of their choices, so practise the explaining here. 'It sounds better' is not an explanation; 'it is stronger and the event was big' is.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業要學生說明其中兩個選擇的理由，所以在這裡先練說明。「聽起來比較好」不算理由；「這個字更強，而且那件事夠大」才算。
items: Upgrade one word in this sentence: My weekend was good.
Then finish: I chose ______ instead of ______ because ______.

5.prep_en: No preparation needed. The eight words split into two teams: usually / often / every day point at the present simple, right now / currently / today point at the present continuous. Teach the signal words and the tense follows.
5.prep_zh: 不必備課。八個字分成兩隊：usually／often／every day 指向現在簡單式，right now／currently／today 指向現在進行式。先教訊號字，時態自己就跟上來了。

words.example: I usually take the bus to school.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在簡單式（習慣）

words.example: We often eat dumplings on Sunday.
She practices the piano every day.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在簡單式 · 放句尾

words.example: Right now I am writing in my notebook.
We are currently studying the water cycle.
words.more: 訊號 → 現在進行式 · 比 right now 正式

words.example: Today we are working in pairs.
words.more: 兩種都可以，看你說的是今天的習慣還是此刻的動作

words.example: The team practices after school every day.
words.more: 第三人稱單數要加 -s：he practices

words.example: I am preparing for the English test this week.

practice.title_zh: 現在還是通常・分類
practice.note_en: For Dom's Teacher Mystery. Read a sentence, students call out NOW or USUALLY, then say how they knew. The answer is always the signal word.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 Dom 的 Teacher Mystery。唸出句子，學生喊 NOW 或 USUALLY，然後說出他們怎麼知道的。答案永遠是訊號字。
items: I am holding a red pen. → NOW
I drink tea every morning. → USUALLY
I usually arrive at seven thirty. → USUALLY
Right now you are listening to me. → NOW
She is standing by the window. → ？
He often forgets his homework. → ？
We are currently reading a new book. → ？
My father cooks dinner every day. → ？

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese verbs do not move
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文的動詞不動
practice.note_en: Chinese says 他去 whether it is he goes or he is going — the verb never changes and there is no am/is/are. So two errors arrive together this week: the missing -s, and the missing be. Show them side by side.
practice.note_zh: 中文說「他去」，不管是 he goes 還是 he is going，動詞都不變，也沒有 am／is／are。所以這週會同時出現兩種錯：漏掉 -s，和漏掉 be 動詞。把它們並排給學生看。
items: 他每天去學校。 ✗ He go to school every day. ✓ He goes to school every day.
他正在打籃球。 ✗ He playing basketball. ✓ He is playing basketball.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ She study English every night.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ They watching a movie right now.

practice.title_zh: 台灣的星期六，美國的星期六
practice.note_en: Dom's culture connection. Students describe a typical Taiwanese Saturday in the present simple, then say what they are doing this particular Saturday in the continuous. Same day, two tenses.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的文化連結。學生先用現在簡單式描述台灣典型的星期六，再用進行式說「這個」星期六在做什麼。同一天，兩種時態。
items: In Taiwan, students usually ______ on Saturday morning.
Many families often ______ on Saturday evening.
But right now, this Saturday, I am ______.
In the United States, children usually ______ on Saturday. (ask the teacher!)

practice.title_zh: 出場券・兩句
practice.note_en: One habit, one action happening now. The pair is the point — one student, one moment, two tenses.
practice.note_zh: 一句習慣，一句此刻。重點在成對——同一個人、同一個時刻，兩種時態。
items: I usually ______ after school.
But right now I am ______.

6.prep_en: No preparation needed. Five of this week's verbs are irregular and three are regular -ed — worth sorting on the board before anything else, because that split is the whole difficulty of the past simple.
6.prep_zh: 不必備課。本週五個動詞是不規則、三個是規則加 -ed——先在白板上分成兩堆，因為過去式的難處全在這條分界線上。

words.example: We went to Lukang last Sunday.
I saw my teacher at the night market.
My grandmother made rice dumplings.
He took the train to Taichung.
I felt nervous before the speech.
We visited my aunt in Kaohsiung.
Something strange happened on the bus.
We decided to walk home.

practice.title_zh: 週末偵探・六條線索
practice.note_en: Dom's activity needs clues, so here they are. Hand them out in order, one at a time. After all six, each team tells the whole story in the past tense — that telling is the real exercise.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的活動需要線索，這裡備好了。一次發一條，照順序。六條發完後，每組用過去式把整個故事講一遍——講的那一段才是真正的練習。
items: Clue 1　On Saturday morning, Mei-Ling took the 7:40 train.
Clue 2　She carried an enormous box and a small umbrella.
Clue 3　At 9:00 the box was empty.
Clue 4　A stranger at the station saw her laughing.
Clue 5　She got home with no umbrella and a puppy.
Clue 6　Her mother was not surprised.
Now tell the story: What happened on Saturday? (at least 8 past-tense verbs)

practice.title_en: The trap · Chinese marks time once
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文只標一次時間
practice.note_en: Chinese puts the pastness in 了 or in a time word, and the verb never moves. English moves the verb — but only once. So two opposite errors appear: no past at all, and past marked twice.
practice.note_zh: 中文把過去放在「了」或時間詞上，動詞本身不動。英文是動詞要變——但只變一次。所以會出現兩種相反的錯：完全沒變，和變了兩次。
items: 我昨天去學校。 ✗ Yesterday I go to school. ✓ Yesterday I went to school.
你昨天去了嗎？ ✗ Did you went? ✓ Did you go?　(did 已經扛了過去)
Your turn — fix this: ✗ She didn't saw the message.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ Last week we visit my grandmother.

practice.title_zh: -ed 有三種唸法
practice.note_en: Students write -ed correctly and then say it wrong. The ending follows the sound before it — no need to memorize lists, just feel where the mouth is.
practice.note_zh: 學生 -ed 寫得對，唸出來卻錯。字尾的唸法由前一個音決定——不必背清單，感覺一下嘴巴在哪裡就知道。
items: /ɪd/ after t or d → visited · decided · wanted · needed
/t/ after a voiceless sound → watched · walked · asked · finished
/d/ after everything else → happened · played · listened · called
Say them across: visited-watched-happened. Feel the difference?

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一句真的事
practice.note_en: Something that really happened last weekend, with one irregular verb underlined. True beats clever.
practice.note_zh: 上週末真的發生的一件事，畫出其中一個不規則動詞。真實比漂亮重要。
items: Last weekend I ______.
Underline the irregular verb you used.

7.prep_en: No preparation needed. The whole week hangs on one contrast: the long action in the background (was doing) and the short action that cuts across it (did). Draw a long line on the board and a short arrow through it — that drawing is the grammar.
7.prep_zh: 不必備課。整週只靠一組對比：背景那個長動作（was doing），和橫切過去的短動作（did）。在白板上畫一條長線，再畫一支箭穿過去——那張圖就是文法。

words.example: I was reading when the phone rang.
While I was cooking, my brother was singing.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
words.more: when 後面通常接過去簡單式

words.example: Suddenly, the lights went out.
Meanwhile, her sister was still sleeping.
words.more: 連接兩個同時進行的場景

words.example: What happened while I was away?
A loud knock interrupted our meeting.
Nobody noticed that the door was open.

practice.title_zh: 定格・五個背景
practice.note_en: For Dom's activity. Read the background, students supply the interruption. The background stays in was/were + -ing; the interruption jumps to past simple. Worked example first.
practice.note_zh: 搭配 Dom 的活動。老師唸背景，學生補上打斷。背景維持 was/were + -ing，打斷跳到過去簡單式。先看示範。
items: Example: I was eating my lunch when a monkey took my banana.
We were practicing for the concert when ______.
While the teacher was writing on the board, ______.
My father was driving home when ______.
The whole class was taking a test when ______.
While we were waiting for the bus, ______.

practice.title_en: The trap · one Chinese word, two English ones
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・中文一個詞，英文兩個
practice.note_en: Chinese uses 的時候 for both. English splits it: while for the long action, when for the short one. If both actions are long, while works for both. If both are short, use when.
practice.note_zh: 中文兩種情況都用「的時候」。英文分家了：while 給長動作，when 給短動作。兩個都長，兩個都用 while；兩個都短，用 when。
items: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。 ✓ I was taking a shower when the phone rang.　(長 → when 接短)
我在洗澡的時候我弟在唱歌。 ✓ While I was taking a shower, my brother was singing.　(兩個都長)
Your turn — fix this: ✗ While the phone rang, I was cooking.
Your turn — choose: I ______ (walk) to school when I ______ (see) my teacher.

practice.title_zh: 萬聖節的打斷
practice.note_en: Dom's Halloween week. Spooky but gentle — the sillier the interruption, the better the grammar sticks.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的萬聖節週。嚇人但別嚇壞——打斷越荒謬，文法記得越牢。
items: I was walking past the old temple when ______.
While my sister was watching a scary movie, ______.
We were handing out candy when suddenly ______.
Meanwhile, in the kitchen, the dog was ______.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個被打斷的瞬間
practice.note_en: One sentence, both tenses, and it has to be true.
practice.note_zh: 一句話，兩種時態，而且要是真的。

8.vocab_label_zh: 10 個字 · 6 個過去分詞 + 4 個訊號字
8.prep_en: No preparation needed, but read the trap card before you teach — the present perfect is the single hardest tense for Chinese speakers, and the reason is specific: 過 and 了 look alike in Chinese and land in different English tenses.
8.prep_zh: 不必備課，但教之前先看一眼陷阱卡——現在完成式是中文母語者最難的一個時態，原因很具體：中文的「過」和「了」長得像，在英文裡卻落在不同的時態。

words.example: I have visited Tainan three times.
Have you ever eaten stinky tofu?
She has seen that movie twice.
We have tried making mooncakes at home.
words.more: 規則　try → tried → tried（y 變 i）

words.example: I have already finished my homework.
He has forgotten his umbrella again.
Have you ever climbed Jade Mountain?
words.more: 只用在問句　Have you ever…?

words.example: I have never been to Japan.
words.more: 本身就是否定，不要再加 not

words.example: We have already eaten lunch.
words.more: 放在 have 和分詞中間

words.example: I haven't finished it yet.
words.more: 用在否定句與問句 · 放句尾

practice.title_zh: 你曾經…？・全班賓果
practice.note_en: Dom asks for bingo, so here is a grid. Students move around, ask the full question, and write a name in a square only after asking one follow-up question. The follow-up is where the real English happens.
practice.note_zh: Dom 要賓果，這裡備好九宮格。學生走動、問完整的問句，追問一題之後才能在格子裡寫名字。追問的那一句才是真正在說英文。
items: …eaten stinky tofu?　|　…visited Taipei 101?　|　…forgotten your homework?
…seen a typhoon?　|　…tried surfing?　|　…met a foreigner before?
…climbed a mountain?　|　…cooked for your family?　|　…been on a night train?
Follow-up must be past simple: When did you…? / How was it? / Who did you go with?

practice.title_en: The trap · 過 and 了 go to different tenses
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・「過」和「了」去了不同的時態
practice.note_en: 過 is experience with no date — that is the present perfect. 了 with a finished time is the past simple. The rule that follows: the present perfect can never sit next to a finished past time. Say 'no dates allowed' and students remember it.
practice.note_zh: 「過」是沒有日期的經驗——那是現在完成式。「了」加上結束的時間點，那是過去簡單式。由此得出一條規則：現在完成式旁邊不能放結束了的時間。告訴學生「完成式不准帶日期」，他們就記得住。
items: 我去過日本。（經驗） ✓ I have been to Japan.
我去年去了日本。（有時間） ✓ I went to Japan last year.
✗ I have gone to Japan last year.　← 完成式不准帶日期
Your turn — fix this: ✗ I have seen that movie yesterday.
Your turn — choose: She ______ (finish) her report already.

practice.title_en: Where the four signal words sit
practice.title_zh: 四個訊號字站在哪裡
practice.note_en: Position is half the battle. ever and already go inside, between have and the participle; yet goes to the end; never replaces the not.
practice.note_zh: 位置就是一半的勝負。ever 和 already 站在中間，夾在 have 和分詞之間；yet 站句尾；never 本身就是否定，不要再加 not。
items: Have you ever eaten it?　　(ever 在中間)
I have already eaten it.　　(already 在中間)
I haven't eaten it yet.　　(yet 在句尾)
I have never eaten it.　　(never 取代 not)
✗ I haven't never eaten it.　← 一個句子只要一個否定

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · one experience, one date
practice.title_zh: 出場券・一個經驗，一個日期
practice.note_en: The pair proves they see the difference. Same event, two tenses, and the second one must carry a time.
practice.note_zh: 成對出現才證明他們看懂了差別。同一件事，兩種時態，第二句一定要帶時間。
items: I have ______ .　(no date allowed)
I ______ last ______ .　(with a date)

9.prep_en: No preparation needed. Four of Dom's five verbs end their third form in -en — that is not a coincidence, it is a family. Point that out and fifteen forms become five patterns.
9.prep_zh: 不必備課。Dom 給的五個動詞裡有四個第三態以 -en 結尾——那不是巧合，是一個家族。把這件事點破，十五個形式就變成五個規律。

words.example: She has gone to the library. (她人還在那裡)
words.more: 自成一格 · 注意 been 和 gone 不同：have been = 去過回來了

words.example: We have eaten all the mooncakes.
He has written three letters this week.
words.more: -en 家族 · 注意雙寫 tt

words.example: Someone has broken the window.
words.more: -en 家族 · 也常用在被動：The window was broken.

words.example: They have chosen the winning team.
words.more: -en 家族 · choose(現在) 兩個 o，chose(過去) 一個

practice.title_zh: 第三態錦標賽・題庫
practice.note_en: Dom's race needs verbs, so here are twelve. Teams call out all three forms; a point for the set, a bonus point for a correct sentence using the third form.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的競賽需要題目，這裡備了十二個。各組喊出三態；答對一組得一分，能用第三態造出正確句子再加一分。
items: (Answers: spoke/spoken · took/taken · gave/given · saw/seen · drove/driven · forgot/forgotten · sang/sung · drank/drunk · began/begun · swam/swum · cut/cut · put/put)

practice.title_zh: 三個家族，不是三十個動詞
practice.note_en: Memorizing a list of thirty is miserable. Sorting them into three shapes is a puzzle. Give students the three patterns and let them file the verbs themselves.
practice.note_zh: 背三十個字很痛苦，把它們歸進三種形狀卻像解謎。給學生三種規律，讓他們自己把動詞歸檔。
items: ① -en 家族：eat-ate-eaten · write-wrote-written · break-broke-broken · choose-chose-chosen · give-gave-given
② i–a–u 家族：sing-sang-sung · drink-drank-drunk · begin-began-begun · swim-swam-swum
③ 三態相同：cut-cut-cut · put-put-put · hit-hit-hit · let-let-let
Which family does 'ring' belong to? And 'shut'?

practice.title_en: The trap · the second form is not the third
practice.title_zh: 陷阱・第二態不等於第三態
practice.note_en: Chinese has one form per verb; English asks for three, and the second and third look similar enough to blur. After have / has / had, it must be the third. Write 'have + ③' on the board and leave it there all lesson.
practice.note_zh: 中文一個動詞只有一個樣子，英文要三個，而第二態和第三態長得夠像，學生會混。have／has／had 後面一定是第三態。在白板寫下「have + ③」，整堂課都不要擦掉。
items: ✗ I have went to Taipei. ✓ I have gone to Taipei.
✗ She has ate already. ✓ She has eaten already.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ They have wrote the report.
Your turn — fix this: ✗ He has broke his glasses.

practice.title_en: Exit ticket · start the Top 30 chart
practice.title_zh: 出場券・開始做三十個動詞表
practice.note_en: Dom's homework is a personal Top 30 chart. Start it here so nobody goes home unsure what it looks like — three columns, five rows, done in class.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的作業是做一張自己的三十動詞表。在課堂上先起頭，沒有人會回家後不知道該長什麼樣——三欄五列，當場完成。
items: Draw three columns: base / past / past participle.
Fill five verbs you will actually use this week.
Write one sentence with a third form: I have ______ .

10.prep_en: No preparation needed. This is the review week, so the nine words are all time signals — each one points at a tense. Teach the signals and the review teaches itself.
10.prep_zh: 不必備課。這是複習週，所以九個字全是時間訊號——每一個都指向一種時態。把訊號教好，複習就自己完成了。

words.example: I finished the book yesterday.
We moved here three years ago.
words.more: → 過去簡單式 · 放在時間長度後面

words.example: While I was studying, it started to rain.
I usually walk to school.
Now I am reading a longer book.
I have studied English since third grade.
words.more: → 現在完成式 · since + 起點

words.example: I have studied English for six years.
words.more: → 現在完成式 · for + 長度

words.example: She has already left.
We have recently started a new project.

practice.title_zh: 用哪個時態？・三個問題
practice.note_en: Not a rule to memorize — a path to walk. Ask the three questions in order and the tense falls out. Put this on the board and leave it up for the rest of the year.
practice.note_zh: 這不是要背的規則，是一條可以走的路。照順序問三個問題，時態自己就掉出來了。把它寫在白板上，接下來一整年都留著。
items: ① Is it finished? No → is it happening right now? Yes → am/is/are + -ing. No → present simple.
② Is it finished? Yes → do you say when? Yes → past simple.
③ Finished but no date, or still true today? → have/has + third form.
Test it: 我學英文六年了。→ still true today → I have studied English for six years.

practice.title_zh: 時光機・四個區
practice.note_en: Dom's game. Mark four corners of the room. Call a zone, students move and must speak in the matching tense within five seconds. Anyone who uses the wrong tense goes back to the middle.
practice.note_zh: Dom 的遊戲。在教室四角標出四個區。喊一個區，學生移動過去，五秒內用對應時態說一句話。用錯時態的回到中間。
items: Corner 1　YESTERDAY → past simple　(I ate breakfast at seven.)
Corner 2　RIGHT NOW → present continuous　(I am standing in the corner.)
Corner 3　IN MY LIFE → present perfect　(I have visited Kenting twice.)
Corner 4　WHEN I WAS YOUNGER → past simple / used to　(I played every afternoon.)

practice.title_zh: since 還是 for？
practice.note_en: Both become 了 in Chinese, so students guess. since takes a point on the calendar; for takes a length. If you can answer 'when did it start?', use since. If you can answer 'how long?', use for.
practice.note_zh: 兩個在中文裡都變成「了」，所以學生只能猜。since 接日曆上的一點，for 接一段長度。能回答「什麼時候開始的」用 since，能回答「多久」用 for。
items: ______ 2020　·　______ six years　·　______ I was eight　·　______ a long time
______ last summer　·　______ three months　·　______ Monday　·　______ ten minutes
Your turn: 我在這間學校待了三年。→ I have been at this school ______ three years.
Your turn: 我從三年級就住在彰化。→ I have lived in Changhua ______ third grade.

practice.title_zh: 出場券・2026 時光膠囊
practice.note_en: Dom's seasonal reset. Four sentences, four tenses, sealed and opened at the end of the year. This doubles as the start of the homework timeline.
practice.note_zh: Dom 指定的季節重整。四句話、四種時態，封起來、年底再打開。這也正好是回家作業那張時間軸的開頭。
items: I usually ______ .　(現在簡單式)
Right now I am ______ .　(現在進行式)
Last month I ______ .　(過去簡單式)
So far this year I have ______ .　(現在完成式)
